verdict.delta_sentence: Compared with the nearer intent-classification reference, this board offers stronger tinted grouping and semantic color but loses finish through several oversized cross-board routes and a less balanced use of the frame.

sub_checks.name: frame_use
sub_checks.note: The eight numbered regions occupy the full canvas, but a broad central-to-lower-right band remains largely empty while the upper flow and lower-left clusters carry most of the visual mass.

sub_checks.name: corridors_and_air
sub_checks.note: Nodes and most pill labels have generous breathing room, though the long green, magenta, orange, and gray corridors compete in the central gap rather than reading as clean sequential lanes.

sub_checks.name: grouping
sub_checks.note: Distinct tinted and titled regions clearly organize ingress, fan-out, queueing, signing, retry, dead-letter, operations, and replay, with mostly two to three nodes per section.

sub_checks.name: color
sub_checks.note: Blue, purple, teal, green, amber, orange, gray, and magenta consistently distinguish functional families and outcomes, although the number of simultaneous hues makes the global flow busier than either reference.

sub_checks.name: machinery_leakage
sub_checks.note: No crosshair junction glyphs or orphaned badges are visible, but several arrows terminate after very long waypointed runs, and the dashed magenta replay route reads partly like exposed routing machinery.

sub_checks.name: alignment_and_rhythm
sub_checks.note: The upper regions share a strong horizontal register and internal node alignment is orderly, but the staggered lower sections and isolated delivery-guarantees card weaken the overall rhythm.

sub_checks.name: edge_legibility
sub_checks.note: Failure: multiple perimeter-scale detours dominate the composition, including the magenta loop from replay toward the queue, the green route spanning signing, admission, and replay, and the top-right dashed teal return.

verdict.rank_order_sanity_note: The assigned scores and visual ordering agree: gc-decomp-harness ranks first, intent-classification-2 second, and the board under grade third because its richer grouping does not offset its conspicuous routing detours and frame imbalance.
